messages:
carmen (Sales): Heads up @tahir @lucy — Orbis wants a short POC next week for their proprietary 30B variant. They say it uses a custom tokenizer + LoRA adapters and will hit a mixed workload (chat + long-doc summarization). Need model catalog fit, tokenizer compatibility, and a POC quote (reserved pool for 1 week + overage). Can we triage today?

tahir (Solutions Eng): Thanks. Can you get me: model bundle (s3 or gs link), sample prompts (chat & doc), and expected qps/avg tokens? Also need to know if tokenizer changes token IDs vs base Llama vocabulary (that matters for embedding alignment).

carmen (Sales): Link incoming: gs://orbis-poc/models/orbis-llama30b-lora-tokenizer-v1.tar.gz (sharing creds now). Workload: mixed — avg 250 tokens for chat, 2500 tokens for long-doc requests (~10% of calls). Peak ~15 rps; sustained ~8 rps.

tahir (Solutions Eng): Quick notes: 1) If tokenizer reindexes tokens we have to map token ids for caching/embeddings. 2) Long-doc tails at 2.5k will stress KV cache; we may need to enable paged KV or segmented generation. 3) LoRA fused into quantized weights can be tricky with int8 -> I prefer float16 for POC unless they insist on int8. I'll fetch the bundle and run a compatibility pass.

lucy (Security): @carmen please ask Orbis for their DPA/SOC2 contact and whether the model weights include customer data. Also flag if they require BYOK for KMS. For POC infra we default to Redwood-managed KMS unless enterprise says otherwise.

sam (AE): Pricing thought — for a 1-week reserved pool with 2x GPUs (to handle peaks) + 24/7 support, suggest we quote a fixed POC fee + per-token overage. I'll model cost assuming sustained 8 rps and avg 500 tokens (weighted), but need infra guidance from @ravi.

ravi (Infra): For 2.5k tails at 15 rps peak we'd recommend a mixed pool: 1x gpu-high-mem instance for long tail and 2x standard inference nodes for chat throughput. If they want int8, we can squeeze more throughput but need validation. Estimate GPU requirement: 3 nodes for safe margin.

tahir (Solutions Eng): Repro snippet I'll use after creds:
```
# run inference test on staging runtime
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/infer
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model_path":"gs://orbis-poc/models/orbis-llama30b-lora-tokenizer-v1","input":"<long_doc_sample>","max_tokens":3000}'
```

ingest-bot: ingest: model-scan queued for gs://orbis-poc/models/orbis-llama30b-lora-tokenizer-v1 9 job=scan_20270401_08

customer_evan (Orbis): Hi team — thanks! Uploaded a small validation set (5 chat, 5 long-doc) and IAM is live for the gs bucket. We prefer BYOK but can start with Redwood KMS for the POC if needed.

tahir (Solutions Eng): Received. First pass plan: (a) validate tokenizer mapping against base llama vocab, (b) run float16 inference for perf numbers, (c) try int8 snapshot with LoRA applied to see delta. I'll post perf table when done.

carmen (Sales): Great. Can we have an initial compatibility summary + a POC quote by EOD? Orbis wants procurement next week.

ravi (Infra): Will provide infra delta and an estimated GPU-hour cost by EOD.

lucy (Security): I'll follow up with a short questionnaire for BYOK and data residency items; will need Orbis security contact for faster turnaround.

tahir (Solutions Eng): One more caution: custom tokenizer may break embeddings used for reranking. If Orbis uses external embedding indices, we need to ensure embedding API/lexicon alignment or provide a migration step. Flagging here so sales can notify customer.

customer_evan (Orbis): Noted — we do have an internal embedding index. We can provide mapping metadata if needed. Thanks all :)
